key.name: primary-limit
key.description: A pop-up always lists every limit; this is the one figure on the button itself. "session" is the default: the current session -- Claude's 5-hour window -- is the limit that decides whether you can keep working right now, which is what a glance at the top bar is asking. A provider with no session limit falls back to its highest. "highest": whichever limit is closest to being used up, wherever it comes from. "weekly": the week's own limit, ignoring the per-model ones.

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the percentage beside the icon
key.description: With this off a button is its icon alone, tinted by how much has been used, and the figures are in the pop-up.

key.name: reset-format
key.summary: How a reset time is worded
key.description: "auto" is what Claude Code's own usage panel does, and the default here: a countdown while the reset is less than a day away ("Resets in 1 hr 1 min"), and a weekday and wall-clock time beyond that ("Resets Tue 3:00 PM"). "relative" is always the countdown, "absolute" always the time, and "both" is the countdown with the time after it in brackets. The time is in your own timezone, on the 12- or 24-hour clock your desktop is set to. Notifications use the same wording.

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which end of the top bar the buttons sit at
key.description: "right" puts them among the status icons, "center" beside the clock, "left" beside Activities. They all go in the same end, side by side.

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position within that end of the top bar
key.description: Where the first button goes, the rest following it in order: 0 is the end nearest the middle of the bar; -1 puts them last. Which neighbours they land between depends on what other extensions have put there.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often to ask the provider for the figures. Opening the pop-up always reads them again, and so does the stored login changing, so a long interval here still gives you fresh numbers when you look.

key.name: warn-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as nearly used up

key.name: critical-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as almost gone

key.name: notify-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which to send a notification
key.description: 0 turns notifications off. Above 0, crossing that percentage notifies once per limit, and not again until that limit resets.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Turning a provider off stops it being read at all, and takes its button with it. A provider whose command-line tool is not installed is left out whatever this says.

key.name: show-per-model
key.description: Some providers meter each model separately as well as the account as a whole. With this off only the whole-account limits are listed.

key.name: show-breakdown
key.description: A line naming which of the provider's surfaces the period's usage came from, when the provider reports it.

key.name: show-credits
key.description: Usage bought beyond the plan's limits, when the provider reports it and you have it turned on with them.
